name: Or Goldreich
bio: My research studies the convergence, stability and statistical properties of stochastic optimization, with a particular focus on how learning-rate schedules and gradient noise shape stochastic gradient descent. Alongside theoretical research, I build applied forecasting projects that connect statistical methods with reproducible computation.
